verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own `pulumi preview` command shows a preview of updates to a stack's resources, and no changes take place, so it is a true dry run before applying. The `--import-file` option also confirms preview can list every resource the program would create. The docs in this pack do not explicitly show a per-resource breakdown of creates, updates, and destroys. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the create/update/delete (and replace) diff breakdown, evidence of destroy visibility in preview, independent or hands-on corroboration of preview accuracy.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can preview exactly what will change — creates, updates, and destroys — before applying

citations.quote: Show a preview of updates to a stack’s resources... No changes to the stack will actually take place.
run `pulumi preview --import-file` to generate an import file listing every resource the program would otherwise create
